findings.description: Active ADR-SAG-0019 says 'equal-input still records whether every backend saw the same canonical bytes'. In a live run every backend gets the same Arc<PayloadBundle>, but r-1 records Attestation::Unattested for all of them, so equal_input.equal() is always false (see the comment at run/mod.rs:340-342 and equal_input/mod.rs:6-8). The old behaviour reported the true state. The only text that licenses 'equal derived from Attestation' is ADR-SAG-0019's r-2b amendment and ADR-SAG-0025. Both are Proposed and not binding, and no Active r-1 amendment covers it. The sprint doc calls this intended, but a contradiction of an Active ADR is Blocking even then.
findings.remediation: Land an Active amendment first, either an ADR-SAG-0019/0008 'Amendment (Phase A.1, r-1)' or an earlier-landing ADR-SAG-0025 attestation subsection. It must state that until backend hashing lands a live run reports equal=false/Unattested. Or keep r-1 equal-input semantics unchanged until the ADR is Active: for example, record Matched when the engine verified that every backend received the same shared Arc bundle.

findings.description: r-1 makes structural and wire-contract decisions that no Active ADR records. ADR-SAG-0027 and the four r-1 amendments cover only errors, features, the backend catalog, test seams, secrets, obs and ScriptedJudge. These are the uncovered decisions: (a) JudgeOutcome.probabilities removed, answers typed as QuestionAnswer, input_sha256 added. (b) EqualInputRecord reshaped (commands deleted, typed backends list, MultiBackendMode, Attestation, equal derived, serialized shape changed). (c) JudgeRequest holds Arc<PayloadBundle> plus CancelToken. (d) Session document version 2 and the 'Phase A session is invalid' rule. (e) Per-answer keys outside choice/confidence/probabilities are dropped from data.answers (sc-ai/src/command.rs:680-689 overwrites the meta 'answers' with typed answers), which departs from Active ADR-SAG-0014 'data holds the verbatim Jev response'. The ADRs that would own these (0014/0019/0008 amendments by 0024/0025) are all Proposed for r-2/r-2b. Answer to your question: the JudgeOutcome and EqualInputRecord shape change is not permitted by the Active ADR text or the r-1 amendments, so it needs an Active ADR-SAG-0025 (or an equivalent r-1 amendment) before r-1 merges.
findings.remediation: Add an Active r-1 amendment (to ADR-SAG-0014, 0019 and 0008, or a new Active ADR) that records the typed answer shape, the EqualInputRecord/Attestation/MultiBackendMode shape, session v2 and the dropped per-answer keys. Alternatively split the attestation and session-v2 changes out to the sprint that lands ADR-SAG-0025. Add an index row and Amended-by markers.

findings.description: ADR-SAG-0027 (docs/architecture.md:1102-1106), the crate architecture doc (docs/sc-agent-types/architecture.md:35-37) and catalog.rs:3 say the catalog and the error-code enums sit in private sibling modules 're-exported at the ids / error paths and the crate root'.
